cmp_ai_lead: It works and makes sense as long as the list is small and someone owns the upkeep.
cmp_ai_p1: If you watch 10 to 20 straightforward career pages, ChatGPT, Claude, or a light workflow in n8n and Apify will genuinely pull new roles each morning. For a one- or two-person desk, that is practical and inexpensive.
cmp_ai_p2: Once the list grows past roughly 50 companies across different ATS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Teamtailor, Teamio), template changes quietly break scrapers every week. Maintenance stops being a one-off setup.
cmp_ai_quote: If there are two of you watching twenty companies, build it in ChatGPT or n8n—you’ll manage fine. If there are ten of you watching a hundred and fifty, you’ll need someone fixing broken scrapers every week.

cmp_faq_a1: Teamio is a company ATS used across Czechia and Slovakia by a large share of employers to power their career pages and Jobs.cz listings—it is not a typical job aggregator. We haven’t found another international monitoring tool that watches local employers across Teamio, Jobs.cz, global ATS systems, and standard career websites together.
cmp_faq_a2: Bulk buying and reselling personal email addresses and mobile numbers outside your existing CRM contacts runs into strict EU GDPR rules. Instead of selling contact lists, TalentRadar surfaces colleagues you already know from your CRM, estimates the likely hiring manager from the role title, and opens a one-click LinkedIn or Google search.
cmp_faq_a3: You upload your target company list from Excel, CSV, or a CRM export. Newly caught and open roles export as ready-to-import files for Bullhorn and Vincere, or as Excel and generic CSV for any other ATS or CRM. Your candidates stay in your own system.
cmp_faq_a4: Not always. Some roles represent continuous or evergreen hiring. Still, passing 45 days usually means the role is at or past normal time-to-fill (39–45 days median in SHRM benchmarking)—giving you a concrete reason to call, not a guarantee of a fee.

cmp_h1: How to spot who’s hiring: comparing five paths and tools
cmp_intro: To keep track of open roles at your agency’s clients and target accounts, there are five common options: from manual checks and DIY AI workflows to specialised tools. Below is a factual guide to what each path covers, what it costs, and when another product fits better than TalentRadar.
cmp_not_h2: 4. When TalentRadar is not for you
cmp_not_i1_body: TalentRadar estimates the likely hiring manager from the role title and opens a one-click search on LinkedIn or Google; we don’t sell credit-based contact records. In the UK and the Netherlands, Recruit Signals or Vente AI handles that.
cmp_not_i1_title: You need verified direct emails and phone numbers
cmp_not_i2_body: Funding rounds, executive changes, and team growth signals are covered by signal platforms such as Recruit Signals or PredictLeads. TalentRadar watches live open roles, role age including 45+ days, and your contact history.
cmp_not_i2_title: You want pre-vacancy signals before a job goes live
cmp_not_i3_body: TalentRadar monitors the specific client and prospect list your agency cares about. Searching the entire unknown market by tech stack belongs to global databases such as TheirStack.
cmp_not_i3_title: You want whole-market search instead of watching your own company list
cmp_not_i4_body: TalentRadar sends morning digests and exports to Excel, CSV, Bullhorn, and Vincere. Real-time Slack alerts and custom webhooks are built into Visualping Business and TheirStack.
cmp_not_i4_title: You need live Slack notifications or webhooks
cmp_not_sub: We would rather point you to the right category than sell you a tool for the wrong job.
cmp_tool_paiger_better: You operate in the UK, want a daily BD planner scored against your ICP plus Contact Finder, and are comfortable with a 12-month contract.
cmp_tool_paiger_caps: Daily BD planner, company matching against your ideal client profile (ICP), hiring manager suggestions, outreach drafts, and paid Contact Finder add-on. Coverage in Czechia/Slovakia unverified.
cmp_tool_paiger_price: £199 / £349 / £699 per month depending on consultant seats, 12-month commitment, setup from £150 (checked 26 Oct 2026).
cmp_tool_rs_better: You win new business in the UK or the Netherlands and want pre-job signals (funding, leadership changes) plus credit-based verified contacts.
cmp_tool_rs_caps: Pre-vacancy signals (funding, new leadership, team growth, posting velocity, departures), live roles with hiring manager, Heat Score (0–100), morning email and app, verified emails/phones on credits, CRM integration built on demand. Explicitly states UK and Dutch markets (Czechia and Slovakia are not listed).
cmp_tool_rs_for: Recruitment agencies (“The growth engine for recruitment agencies.”).
cmp_tool_rs_price: Solo €99 / Agency €299 / Scale €599 per month billed annually excl. VAT (100 / 350 / 1,000 credits, 1 user / unlimited users); monthly billing is 20% higher, cancel any time; 7-day free trial with no card (checked 13 Nov 2026).
cmp_tool_ts_better: You want raw global job and tech-stack data via API and webhooks (n8n, Make, Zapier), including closed-role events, without an agency workflow.
cmp_tool_ts_caps: Global database of job postings and technologies (371k sources, 195 countries, including Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Teamtailor, Personio, job boards, LinkedIn, Indeed), closed-role tracking (job.closed), daily/weekly saved-search emails, API, webhooks, Zapier, Make, n8n. Czechia is not among the 10 countries listed with sufficient data (its Czechia page returns 404).
cmp_tool_ts_for: B2B sales, marketing, and data teams; recruitment agencies are one use case.
cmp_tool_ts_price: Free tier with 50 company + 200 API credits/month; API plans from $49/month (1,500 credits, 1 job = 1 credit) up to $5,500/month; web app one-off from $109 per 1,000 companies (checked 13 Nov 2026).
cmp_tool_vente_better: You operate in the UK, run Bullhorn, Vincere, JobAdder, or Loxo, want two mobile contacts per lead, and accept an annual commitment.
cmp_tool_vente_caps: Vacancy leads with hiring manager details (2 mobile contacts per lead), Hiring Stress Score, filters out agency ads, pushes leads into Bullhorn, Vincere, JobAdder, and Loxo. Coverage in Czechia/Slovakia unverified.
cmp_tool_vente_for: UK recruitment agencies with an existing ATS.
cmp_tool_vente_price: £149–£699 per month by credit volume (100–2,000 leads), annual commitment billed quarterly, no free trial (checked 26 Oct 2026).
cmp_tool_vp_better: You watch 5 to 20 simple career pages—or unrelated URLs such as pricing pages or tenders—on a minimal or free budget.
cmp_tool_vp_caps: Monitors visual and text changes on arbitrary URLs, includes AI change summaries and “AI alert criteria” (“Alert me when…”), delivers email, webhooks, and Slack on Business plans. Does not parse ATS feeds or track role age as a database.
cmp_tool_vp_for: Anyone who needs to watch changes on any public web page.
cmp_tool_vp_price: Free plan (5 pages); Personal $14–$70/month; Business from $140/month for 200 pages and 5 users (checked 13 Nov 2026).

faq_a1: No. TalentRadar runs next to it and nothing moves. A list of companies from your CRM or a spreadsheet is enough. You download the new roles as a file to import into Bullhorn or Vincere, or as a generic CSV. There’s no direct ATS connection yet.
faq_a2: Not at all. Watching companies and roles needs no ATS. If you want one, every plan includes Radar + ATS: candidates, contacts, jobs, pipeline and placements. It’s deliberately simple, built for small agencies.
faq_a3: It reads roles from Jobs.cz and Teamio, from company ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Personio, BambooHR, Teamtailor, Recruitee, Pinpoint, HireHive, Phenom, Jibe, SuccessFactors, Oracle Recruiting, Eightfold) and from ordinary career pages. Out of it you get Excel, a generic CSV and an import file for Bullhorn and Vincere. We connect unusual career pages on request in the Scale plan.
faq_a4: When the ad disappears from the site, the next scan notices, the one after confirms it, and TalentRadar archives the role. A careers page that’s briefly down won’t wipe your list. If the company posts the role again, it comes back with its history and notes.
faq_a5: The trial lasts 14 days, with no credit card, the features of the Agency Pro plan and up to 150 companies. The first 5 agencies get the first month free instead, then 3 months at half price. Three days before the end you get an e-mail. If you want to carry on, you pick a plan in the app and I send you an invoice. The trial never turns into a paid plan by itself.
faq_a6: No. When you search for a candidate you only paste the profile, and once you’ve searched it’s gone. Before anything goes to the AI we take out the name, e-mail, phone and links. Candidates are stored only if you add them yourself in Radar + ATS.
faq_a7_html: TalentRadar is run by its founder, Kryštof Pejša, who is also the controller of personal data. Every agency has its own separate database and sees only its own data. Who helps us run the website and the form, and how long we keep the data, is set out in our privacy policy.
faq_a8: We read only what companies publish for job seekers themselves: public career pages and public ATS APIs. We don’t read LinkedIn automatically; you open the search link yourself.

proof_story: It started at an agency in Dublin: over two months the radar watched 180 companies there and caught more than 3,400 open roles.
story_body_html: In Dublin I worked at Ingenio Global, the recruitment agency run by Rob Magee. Every Monday morning, experienced headhunters there went through clients’ career pages and copied links into spreadsheets. So I wrote a system that does it by itself. For the next two months it ran in production: it watched 180 companies and caught more than 3,400 open roles. That system is now TalentRadar. When you get in touch, you deal with me directly.
story_h2: Built inside an agency, for agencies
story_short_m: In Dublin I watched experienced headhunters go through clients’ career pages every Monday and copy links into spreadsheets. I wrote a system that does it by itself: over two months it followed 180 companies and caught more than 3,400 open roles. Today it is TalentRadar.
trial_ai_brief:
Prepare a company list for TalentRadar, a service that tracks where companies are hiring.

Source: [attach a CRM export or your client list, or describe the sectors and region we care about]

Return only the table as plain text, with no introduction, no comment and no code block. At most 150 rows. The separator is a semicolon. The first row must be exactly:
Company;Careers page;Last contact;Had placement

Rules:
- Company: the company name, each company only once.
- Careers page: the address of the page with open roles, or at least the company website, only if you are sure of it. Don't make addresses up.
- Last contact: the date of the last contact with the company as 15/03/2024, only if it is in the source. Otherwise empty.
- Had placement: yes or no, only if the source says so. Otherwise empty.
- Do not include people's names, emails, phone numbers or candidates.

Example:
Company;Careers page;Last contact;Had placement
Air Bank;airbank.cz/careers;15/03/2024;yes
Rohlik Group;rohlik.cz;;

trial_ai_text: Copy this brief into the AI your company uses, such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or Gemini, and attach a CRM export or your client list. Paste the finished table into the box here.
trial_ai_title: The easiest way: let your AI prepare the list
trial_call: Rather go through it together? Book a 15-minute demo.
trial_candidates_note: Please don’t send us candidates. You try the candidate search in the app, and the profile isn’t stored.
trial_clients_help: Prefer to do it by hand? What the list should look like, with a CSV template
trial_gdpr_html: By submitting you agree to the processing of your contact details to create a trial account. We never sell your details or pass them on for marketing. (Privacy policy)
trial_headline: Try it on your own companies
trial_hint_clients: Active clients and target companies, each with a link to its careers page. A company website also works: we try to find the careers page from it, though not always successfully.
trial_list_optional: Not ready to share your clients? A few target companies are enough to try it.
trial_list_privacy: We use your company list only for your trial account and never pass it on. An uploaded file deletes itself after 90 days.
trial_placeholder_clients: One company per line, e.g. “Air Bank; airbank.cz/volne-pozice” or “Rohlik Group; rohlik.cz”.
trial_promo: The first 5 agencies: the first month free, then 3 months at half price.
trial_promo_after: Once the 5 places are taken, the 14-day free trial applies.
trial_step1: A confirmation e-mail arrives right away.
trial_step2: We automatically set up your trial account, try to find the careers page for companies without a link and run the first scan.
trial_step3: After the first scan you get an e-mail to sign in. Within 2 hours you’ll see in the app where your companies are hiring.
trial_step_fallback: If anything gets stuck, say with an unusual careers page, I’ll get in touch personally.
trial_subtext: The first scan of your companies runs automatically, and within 2 hours you’ll see in the app where they’re hiring.
trial_upload_cta: Upload your company list or a CRM export
